breakdown.description: The prompt sets the free-end rotation to zero, even though a cantilever’s free end is generally free to rotate under an end point load.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly computes a non-zero free-end slope θ = PL²/(2EI) = 0.0135 rad, demonstrating that the free end is allowed to rotate under the point load, contrary to the incorrect instruction to set it to zero.

breakdown.description: The prompt treats the bending moment as constant and equal to P L over the entire span, even though the cantilever moment varies linearly from the free end to the fixed end.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification uses the standard cantilever formulas θ = PL²/(2EI) and δ = PL³/(3EI), which are derived from the linearly varying bending moment distribution, not a constant moment PL over the full span.
